name: Foxy Lady - Jimi Hendrix
guitar: Fender Stratocaster (single-coils, neck pickup, vintage vibrato)

efx.notes: Emulates the vintage fuzz pedal aggression and sustaining upper harmonics used for the main riff.

amplifier.notes: Pushed Marshall 1959 Plexi sound giving classic output valve grit and touch sensitivity.

cabinet.notes: Greenback 4x12 cab response matching vintage British tone stacks.

guitar_settings.notes: Stratocaster neck pickup for that warm, glassy, singing blues-rock attack.

playing_notes: Heavy use of vibrato arm phrasing, aggressive pick attack on the open E-string riffing, and volume-knob cleanup for rhythm dynamics.
